# agentkai docs

> agentkai is an open-source personal AI agent (pip install agentkai) that
> runs on your own computer. It is model-agnostic: bring your own model
> (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Ollama, GLM) and keep the same tools, memory,
> scheduler, and dashboard. This is the documentation index.

Canonical base: https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/
Source: https://github.com/Bilal-Junaid-Jiwani/agentkai

## Pages

- [Quickstart](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/quickstart.html): Get from zero to a working agent in a few minutes.
- [Models](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/models.html): AgentKai is model-agnostic. The provider layer is LiteLLM, so one agent codebase works with 100+ models. You pick the model per run, per job, or per channel; everything else (tools, memory, scheduler, dashboard) stays the same.
- [Dashboard](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/dashboard.html): The local web dashboard: chat with the agent, watch runs stream, replay past runs event-by-event, browse memory, and inspect scheduler jobs — all in the browser, all offline.
- [Tools](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/tools.html): Tools are what the agent can do. Every tool is a plain Python callable described by a JSON Schema, so every model provider that supports function calling (via LiteLLM) gets the same toolset. Tool calls are normalized across providers — the tools never know which model is behind them.
- [Browser](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/browser.html): The agent drives a real Chromium (via Playwright) — not a text scraper. It can navigate, read rendered pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, go back, and download files. Logins persist in the browser profile, so signing in once keeps working across runs.
- [Memory](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/memory.html): AgentKai's memory is plain markdown files in ~/.agentkai/memory/. No database, no embeddings service, no black box: you can read every file, edit them by hand, and version them with git. The agent reads the core files at the start of each run and appends what it learns.
- [Scheduler](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/scheduler.html): Background jobs that run while you're away: cron-style recurring tasks, one-shot timers, a heartbeat check-in, and nightly "dreaming" (memory consolidation). Jobs live in SQLite (~/.agentkai/scheduler.db), so they survive restarts.
- [Channels — the messaging gateway](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/channels.html): agentkai gateway connects chat apps to the agent. One daemon, many channels; every conversation is an isolated session with its own agent run and event log. Chat from your phone, get answers and approvals from wherever you are.
- [Skills](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/skills.html): A skill is a reusable playbook: a SKILL.md file (YAML frontmatter — name, description, version, when-to-use — plus markdown instructions the agent reads) with an optional tools.py exposing get_tools(config). Skills teach the agent how to do a domain well; tools give it the hands.
- [Voice](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/voice.html): Speech-to-text and text-to-speech with two honest provider tiers. Nothing is faked: if no provider is available, the tools return a clear error saying exactly what to install or configure.
- [Media generation](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/media.html): Image tools for the agent: generate_image, edit_image, and an experimental generate_video. Read the limits first — they're the point.
- [Devices](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/devices.html): Pair your phone or laptop so the agent can reach it: push notifications, SMS via the device's own stack, contacts, and calendar. AgentKai never talks to a phone directly — it talks to the AgentKai companion app over plain HTTPS. The app is the thing that can touch SMS and contacts; the agent just asks it.
- [Goals & tracking](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/goals.html): Two related systems for things that outlive one conversation, both in SQLite (~/.agentkai/goals.db):
- [Privacy](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/privacy.html): AgentKai runs on your computer. The agent loop, tools, memory files, scheduler database, dashboard, and messaging gateway are all local processes reading and writing ~/.agentkai/. There is no AgentKai cloud, no account, no telemetry, no analytics.
- [Troubleshooting](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/troubleshooting.html): Fixes for common install, CLI, provider, dashboard, scheduler, and gateway problems.
- [Changelog](https://bilal-junaid-jiwani.github.io/agentkai/changelog.html): All notable changes to agentkai are documented here. Versioning follows SemVer: MINOR for features, PATCH for fixes.
